boosters_i18n.zh-TW: 鳴鳳古道（客家委員會客庄小旅行列名台灣百大古道，橫跨獅潭鄉新店村與頭屋鄉鳴鳳村；原賽夏族狩獵山路、後為粵籍隘墾民貨運要道，今為熱門健行與春季賞桐路線；賞桐季窗為官方生態資訊但查無可繫結的逐窗契約資料源，誠實不建時間窗）古道主體（OSM footway 節點；海拔誠實留空）；與既有 tw-127 仙山靈洞宮後山（4.01km）題材錯位。
boosters_i18n.en: Mingfeng trail (listed by the Hakka Affairs Council's Hakka-village portal among Taiwan's 100 great trails; crossing Shitan and Touwu townships, an old Saisiyat hunting path turned cargo route, now a popular hike and spring tung-blossom route). Tung windows are official ecology notes but no bindable per-window data source - honestly no time-window contract; disjoint from tw-127 Xianshan Lingdong temple back-hill 4.01 km away.
boosters_i18n.ja: 鳴鳳古道（客家委員会公式、台湾百大古道、獅潭と頭屋を跨ぐ）（OSM）。油桐の季節窓は権威源がなく誠実に不構築。仙山とは題材が別。

penalties_i18n.en: Severe weather, poor visibility, outside operating/season window.
penalties_i18n.ja: 悪天候、視程不良、営業・季節窓外。
